# Accessibility_Gradient

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A spatial or temporal gradient in the ease of accessing computational elements, analogous to synaptic weight gradients but applied to connectivity or resource availability. Provides a biologically-inspired mechanism for iNEST architectures to implement hierarchical or region-specific plasticity, improving adaptability in neuromorphic hardware.
